material_findings.finding: A group and underlying array path do not uniquely select the multiscales coordinate context. J9 explicitly carries owner plus selected entry through artifact:campaign/cache/details/navigation, and exposes a shared-array/different-transform oracle.
material_findings.remedy: When a group contains multiple entries, record which entry defines the admitted displayed view and include that context in view/cache identity. Do not reuse calibrated or overlay state solely by array path. Keep an entry-chooser UI and exhaustive multi-entry display unapproved.
material_findings.provenance: Actual J9 participant comparison L-48b8e76e269e; evaluator proposes narrow insertion into existing groups. Primary U-S00092 metadata-ownership issue and U-S00081 multiple-entry issue plus final group-relative metadata rules; no runtime bug reproduced.

material_findings.finding: Several concrete-repair blocks require all plate/FOV/acquisition/series coverage as positive acceptance. Format routing correctness does not itself settle admitted container breadth.
material_findings.remedy: Retain current draft lines 17/19 conditionals. Apply per-field/series identity checks to supported container organizations; preserve rejected/unsupported diagnostics and hold unconditional positive breadth. Do not count this as a separate native failure for every repeated block.
